manifest.description: Connect prior Blackbox operator or agent history to current Rust code to diagnose architectural pressure and trend.
when_to_use: operator complaints, notes, threads, failed fixes, or abandoned refactors mention the same Rust area repeatedly
git churn alone is insufficient and narrative history must be checked against current code
a correction plan needs transcript anchors, dates, current state, and trend
anti_patterns: do not use for pure churn counts without narrative anchors
do not use when current code no longer matches the historical complaint
do not use on non-Rust targets
